summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The KraneShares 2x Long BABA Daily ETF (KBAB) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in consumer discretionary equity. The fund provides 2x leveraged exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Alibaba Group Holding Limited stock (ticker: BABA). KBAB was launched on Mar 11, 2025 and is issued by KraneShares.
